steps.content:
March 16, N.F. 113, 00:44
Secret Passage, Level 28, East District, Drifter Camp
Mulling over the relayed information, you walk up.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Those umbrella salesmen are being bold this time. They showed up personally at the risk of getting targeted by the Spider. ${PlayerName} knows what this means.

Yes. Parma is a cunning, prudent conspirator. He manipulates his puppets to do the dirty deeds for him. He knows how to trigger a disastrous tempest with the slightest move and retreat without ever exposing his identity.

They've only shown themselves twice, during the incidents of <color=#fb9259>BR-001</color> and <color=#fb9259>BR-004</color>. If you're not mistaken, he only risks exposing himself when it's certain he can trigger a Black Ring.
This place is no doubt in danger now.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: No matter how well that Corpus is hidden, it was brought in by someone. As long as you can find <color=#fb9259>that man</color>, you can solve the whole crisis. ${PlayerName} must think that, and so do I. I've waited here for a long time for them to show up.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: But we're all mistaken. Parma didn't bring that thing.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: Just like ${PlayerName}, they chased all the way to Drifter Camp to find the whereabouts of this Corpus. They can't locate it either.
...What does that mean? A <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color> free from Parma's control? A Corpus even Parma fails to find? What exactly is this thing, and why did it choose the Drifter Camp?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: What baffles me most is this... Why did it choose the Drifter Camp?

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: As cowardly as they are, the people here are mostly good folks. It's both costly and risky to try to convert them into useful pawns. Beats me...

Indeed. Corpus are naturally attracted to Mania, just like what happened to the <color=#fb9259>gangsters</color> in the crypt, <color=#fb9259>Zoya</color>, and the <color=#fb9259>Carnival</color> 23 years ago. But Mania wasn't even common in the Drifter Camp to begin with.

Why did Parma leave? Have they given up on this plan? Was it because they were targeted by the 9th Agency? Because of you? No. Corpus must be rare resources. Now that they're already here, they won't give up.
<size=40>Could it be that...</size>
The matters here have been properly arranged. By the time you arrive, it should be ready too.

That's it. Unlike you, Parma doesn't need to find it. As long as he can confirm that the Corpus is here and that it can trigger a Black Ring, that's enough. Parma and his raincoat men can achieve their goal simply by feeding the terror.
Your palms sweat, and you can't help quickening your steps.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Che's injury is too bad, he must be treated soon. I have to escort him down. The thing you've told me, I'll find a chance to tell Nightingale about it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Now, are you going on with your investigation? In that case, there's another thing Che wants me to tell you.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: "If that loony still won't give up, tell him to go to vent E-8."
steps.female_content: "If that loony still won't give up, tell her to go to vent E-8."

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: "That's the last stop of Parma's investigation. He stayed there for a long time."

steps.speaker: [Scene change, large vent]
steps.content: [Scene change, large vent]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you sure it's here?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Vent E-8. According to Julien's map, this is it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But there's nothing here? No monsters, no contamination. I even prepared myself mentally, but this is so... underwhelming?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Has that Corpus really been here?
You've seen this place before.
In that dream during your suspended animation. That premonition.
The hidden contamination, the invisible monsters, the silent infiltration. You're certain. The blatant mess staged by Parma above is not its thing. This place is.
You put the Hypercubes in the two Sinners' hands.

steps.speaker: I'm fighting against a terrible, terrible thing.
options: Stay away from me. Protect yourselves.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, what are you going to do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It took us a great deal of effort to get here. If we don't take a little risk, we can't see it.

You still remember what you saw in the dream. You remember the handprints on the wall, and where the dragged scorch marks have been. You try your best to weaken the shackles connected to the Sinners, and walk ahead alone.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Touch where the scorch marks have been

steps.content: Sustaining the shackles with your hand, you touch the dusty floor. Flames burn all over you instantly. Everything in your sight twists rapidly. Your sanity is torn, and your vision dims quickly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?!
You can't see anymore. What remains in your sight are the vivid scorch marks, spreading flames, and palmprints. A screeching howl comes piercing...
